tier2_candidates.headline: GLP-1s are forcing a strategic reset across healthcare: Wells Fargo report
tier2_candidates.snippet: GLP-1s are disrupting a healthcare system built around treating obesity-related complications, forcing providers, insurers and investors to rethink where future revenue and growth will come from, according to a new report from Wells Fargo.

tier2_candidates.headline: HHS announces $96.7M in grants for behavioral health services
tier2_candidates.snippet: Services provided include support for homeless individuals with serious mental illness, suicide prevention and early intervention, SUD treatment, peer support and more.

tier2_candidates.headline: Many Medicare beneficiaries are confident they understand the program. The data says otherwise
tier2_candidates.snippet: While many individuals believe they have a firm grasp on their Medicare benefits, the reality is far different, according to a new survey.

tier2_candidates.headline: How Louisiana’s New Surgeon General Wants To Transform Public Health
tier2_candidates.snippet: Evelyn Griffin is pushing for more emphasis on wellness and prevention. She has also aligned with the MAHA movement in fighting government mandates and questioning the safety of some vaccines.

tier2_candidates.headline: Watch: Mark Cuban Says You Can’t Fix Healthcare Until Every Price Is Known
tier2_candidates.snippet: With his online pharmacy, Mark Cuban changed how generic drugs are sold — and he has thoughts about how to fix the healthcare system. The billionaire businessman talks to KFF Health News’ Julie Rovner to answer the question: “How Would You Fix It?”

tier2_candidates.headline: New DOJ Guidance Could Give States Cover To Cut Disability Services
tier2_candidates.snippet: A new rule from the Justice Department upends a 25-year-old interpretation of federal disability law. Advocates fear it could result in cuts to services that help many disabled Americans live at home instead of in institutions.

tier2_candidates.headline: Seattle Times Columnist Resigns After Paper Scrapped Trans Sports Column
tier2_candidates.snippet: Matt Calkins, a longtime sports columnist, said editors had refused to publish a column about transgender athletes in women’s competitions.
